description: Bicep network security group allowing SSH from any address
note: CIS Azure 7.2. SSH open to * from the internet. Bicep now has two sources, not one. KICS parses .bicep natively where Trivy has no Bicep scanner at all, so this case's self-check compares two tools and the single-source caveat multi-iac-spec §4 carried for Bicep is retired.
